dataset_source.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
dataset_source.attribution: Source data: Tiago F. T. Cerqueira, Antonio Sanna and Miguel A. L. Marques, Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds, Materials Cloud 2023.163 v1, DOI 10.24435/materialscloud:qv-bq, CC BY 4.0. This catalogue is a derived projection with additional source-state screening commentary.

scope: Previously private source-model screening is now published as unscored source-computed material-design hypotheses. Historical private-screening wording is retained as context. These predictions are new to this reviewed catalogue only; experimental confirmation, worldwide first discovery, formal RPS and human scientific review are not claimed.
source_tc_scope: Source isotropic Eliashberg Tc in K at mu*=0.1 is a model result, not experimental Tc. It is a separate source product and is not associated with an individual Gaussian width or a numerical uncertainty interval.
pairing_response_scope: Retained ten-width lambda contrasts and independent source Tc products support bounded source-model comparisons. Chemical, mass, volume, sampling, spin and SOC effects can co-change; no universal causal or error-bound interpretation is assigned.
risk_tag_scope: Attention labels support browsing. Element labels are not measured magnetic ground states, rejection criteria or calibrated potential scores; no label does not mean no risk.

candidate.prototype: R-3m four-site layered nitride: distinct Y and Nb single-site layers and a two-site N orbit
candidate.prototype_evidence: R-3m four-site layered nitride: distinct Y and Nb single-site layers and a two-site N orbit
candidate.support_meaning: Preliminary screened support within the stated source model. This ordinal level is not a probability, formal RPS score or human scientific review.
candidate.risk_summary: A concrete competing structure exists: Pilemalm et al. predict a distorted YNbN2 relative to the binaries, while their YTaN2 is unfavorable. Those different relaxed metrics/DFT methods are not the exact R-3m source state and are not imported as its hull energy. The source state is locally stable at Gamma and sampled path, so the prior supplies a falsifiable distortion/decomposition risk rather than automatic rejection. Nitrogen defects/order and suppressed magnetism remain possible; a reported ScMN2 semiconductor result is not assumed to be the exact YNbN2 metallic EPC phase.
candidate.ambient_scope: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0.023729741 eV/A, P=-0.003 GPa, full max stress=0.103 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.
candidate.route_response: Nb replaces Ta on the unique transition-metal layer, retaining the Y and two N roles. The actual volume rises 0.6563% and nearest Y-N, Nb-N and N-N responses are retained. The favorable lambda sign persists across all ten sigma values, with a favorable separate Eli mu=.1 comparison retained below. This is a coupled layer-chemistry/construction response, not a valence-to-mobile-n inference.
candidate.next_action: Compare the actual R-3m source to the published distorted YNbN2 ordering with identical composition/functional and test the lowest distortion channel; preserve the Nb/Ta matched pairing contrast. A stable local R-3m basin with persistent coupling gain supports screening; a barrierless symmetry-breaking distortion or vanished metallic pairing response opposes it.

seven_criteria.identity: Complete ordered CIF/literal coarse-fine input/Gamma periodic species-site association is numerically supported; source input geometry and full tensor/forces are retained. Export occupancy is a discrete computational convention; source experimental P/T/occupancy and actual compiled unit constant are unknown. Exact-version input defaults scope the configured neutral scalar spin1/noSOC model, not magnetic ground state.
seven_criteria.quantitative_route_response: Nb replaces Ta on the unique transition-metal layer, retaining the Y and two N roles. The actual volume rises 0.6563% and nearest Y-N, Nb-N and N-N responses are retained. The favorable lambda sign persists across all ten sigma values, with a favorable separate Eli mu=.1 comparison retained below. This is a coupled layer-chemistry/construction response, not a valence-to-mobile-n inference.
seven_criteria.pairing_relevance: Exact target and mapped control direct source lambda arrays have the same favorable sign at all ten common broadening tokens; omega_ln has explicit K units and separate Eli/McM mu=.1 tables remain independent. Same underlying q mesh is observed. The sensitivity range is not a physical error bound; sigma units, full-BZ convergence, experimental Tc and pure-geometry causality remain unknown. Literal method differences are declared confounds.
seven_criteria.ambient_feasibility: Both source SCFs converge, near-zero coarse forces/stress and bounded fine response are measured. Fine Fmax=0.023729741 eV/A, P=-0.003 GPa, full max stress=0.103 GPa. Gamma optical compression is positive beyond printing bound and sampled path has no signed negative values. All listed q outputs have JOBDONE/last response convergence and no routine errors. This supports a finite-grid local/metastable source model, not global hull or experimental synthesis.
seven_criteria.competition_and_coherence: A concrete competing structure exists: Pilemalm et al. predict a distorted YNbN2 relative to the binaries, while their YTaN2 is unfavorable. Those different relaxed metrics/DFT methods are not the exact R-3m source state and are not imported as its hull energy. The source state is locally stable at Gamma and sampled path, so the prior supplies a falsifiable distortion/decomposition risk rather than automatic rejection. Nitrogen defects/order and suppressed magnetism remain possible; a reported ScMN2 semiconductor result is not assumed to be the exact YNbN2 metallic EPC phase.
seven_criteria.novelty: 2019 primary work explicitly treats hypothetical distorted YNbN2, so the composition is not newly predicted here. The dated YNbN2/YTaN2 search found no exact experimental superconducting R-3m YNbN2 benchmark. The proposed novel object is the matched Nb-for-Ta source-state hypothesis at stated scalar finite-grid approximation.
seven_criteria.decision: Compare the actual R-3m source to the published distorted YNbN2 ordering with identical composition/functional and test the lowest distortion channel; preserve the Nb/Ta matched pairing contrast. A stable local R-3m basin with persistent coupling gain supports screening; a barrierless symmetry-breaking distortion or vanished metallic pairing response opposes it.
